thinking_text:
**Considering port placements**

I'm thinking about potential changes to the existing gold ports in the lower-left area. There are two small gold ports there already, which might serve as an inlet/outlet. The requested edit could involve adding ports to a radiator, starting from the current configuration. The images confirm these two ports are present. It seems the request might be to move one to the top-right position, indicating we need to identify where the outlet and inlet need to go.

request.raw_text: Hi , Please create an outlet port on the top right and an inlet port on the bottom left .

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Upper-right region of the radiator frame or side tank
areas_to_change.location: Top-right corner when viewed from the fan-facing +X side
areas_to_change.description: Add a fluid outlet connection integrated with the radiator tank near the upper-right corner. The port should open into the internal coolant volume and project outward with a usable hose or fitting interface.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Lower-left region of the radiator frame or side tank
areas_to_change.location: Bottom-left corner when viewed from the fan-facing +X side
areas_to_change.description: Add or configure a fluid inlet connection integrated with the radiator tank near the lower-left corner. Existing gold-colored fittings in this area may need to be reused, replaced, or consolidated to provide the requested inlet.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the core dimensions, fin pattern, and active heat-transfer area except for the minimum local tank modifications needed to connect the ports.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Dual fan assemblies and protective grilles
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve both fans, blades, hubs, grilles, alignment, and clearance from the radiator.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Upper and lower frame members and side tanks
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the overall envelope and structural form, allowing only localized changes at the specified port locations.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Filler neck, cap, mounting bosses, and corner features
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their geometry and placement, and maintain sufficient clearance between them and the new ports.
Preserve the Fusion 360 marking and all unaffected visible surfaces.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The radiator will have an outlet fitting at the upper-right and an inlet fitting at the lower-left, referenced from the fan-facing +X view. Both ports will be connected through the corresponding tank walls to the coolant passages.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The lower-left port will admit coolant into the radiator, while the upper-right port will discharge cooled coolant.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: Coolant will flow generally diagonally from the lower-left inlet toward the upper-right outlet through the radiator core, while the two fans continue to drive airflow through the fins.

ambiguities.description: The viewing direction used to define top-right and bottom-left is not explicitly stated.
candidate_interpretations: Use the fan-facing +X view, placing the outlet at upper-right and the inlet at lower-left.
Use the branded rear-facing -X view, which mirrors the left-right locations.
Use the assembly's intrinsic CAD coordinate system rather than a visual front view.

ambiguities.description: Port diameter, fitting standard, projection direction, and connection style are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Match the diameter and hose-barb style of the existing gold-colored fittings.
Create threaded ports sized to the radiator wall and available clearance.
Create plain cylindrical hose-neck ports with manufacturable wall thickness.

ambiguities.description: Two gold-colored fittings already appear near the lower-left corner in the fan-facing view.
candidate_interpretations: Reuse one existing fitting as the requested inlet and relocate or remove the other.
Retain both existing fittings and add a separate inlet nearby.
Replace the existing pair with one inlet at the lower-left and create a new outlet at the upper-right.

ambiguities.description: The required internal tank routing and sealing construction are not defined.
candidate_interpretations: Connect each port directly to the nearest existing tank volume.
Add internal partitions to enforce lower-left-to-upper-right coolant flow.
Modify only the external port geometry without changing the current internal flow arrangement.
